name: Nonomura Taeko
source:
A disconcertingly impoverished girl, bereaved of both her parents and living on her own with her younger brother.

She holds numerous part-time jobs, originally starting out with one delivering milk. In spite of her miserable circumstances, her cheerful disposition gives her the drive to keep doing her best every day.

Incidentally, yakisoba bread is like haute cuisine to her.

Likes: Yakisoba bread, her brother [url=/c20894]Atsushi[/url]
Dislikes: Frogs (incredibly so)
Hobbies: Her numerous part-time jobs
